Get started

You can have a site you edit yourself up and running in an afternoon.

  1. 1

    Your repository

    Your site gets its own repository on GitHub, with Interstellar installed from npm (@interstellarcms/cms).

  2. 2

    Your hosting

    Cloudflare builds your site every time you save and serves it worldwide.

  3. 3

    Your editor

    Open /editor/ on your site, sign in with GitHub, and make your first change.

What you’ll need

  • A free GitHub account
  • A free Cloudflare account
  • A domain name, if you want your own address

We’re happy to help.
